candidates.change_summary: Replace call to withdraw(address(this).balance) with withdraw(0) so withdrawAll sends 0 instead of full balance.
Remove onlyOwner modifier so withdrawAll becomes callable by anyone.
Change to call sendMoney to send the balance using call instead of withdraw/transfer, altering external behavior (and gas/forwarding).
Invert onlyOwner require to require(msg.sender != owner), allowing only non-owners to pass the check and thus changing who can call withdrawAll.
Replace transfer to send (using return value) so withdraw no longer reverts on failure but may silently fail (affecting observed balance after call).
Replace transfer with low-level call that returns (does not revert on failure) and ignores returned data, changing whether failed sends revert (affects resulting balances).
Relax onlyOwner check to allow either owner or the contract itself to call (changing who can call withdraw and thus observed behavior).
Replace low-level call with a checked call that reverts on failure, changing whether funds/state remain modified when target call fails.
Use send instead of call, which forwards a limited amount of gas and returns false on failure; this can change whether value is actually transferred and thus observed after the call.
Use transfer instead of call, which reverts on failure and forwards limited gas, altering behavior for many targets.
Relax the access check to allow any caller (remove ownership requirement), changing who can call sendMoney and thus externally observable behavior.
